endorsements.quote: AI systems are as good as their training data; hence, biased data may lead to biased outcomes.

Indeed, it will be essential to ensure transparency in the decision-making processes of algorithms and to promote the training of doctors in the critical use of these technologies, with future specific regulations.

unlisted_practices: Design AI systems that complement rather than replace the unique strengths of human clinicians.
Develop healthcare-specific regulations addressing liability for AI-driven medical decisions.
Foster collaboration among healthcare professionals, AI developers, and policymakers in AI integration.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/perspective piece examining the impact of AI on pediatric residents' training, workload, and quality of life, without presenting original empirical data.
